fusions.name: Prying Fingers
fusions.desc: A quick pinch with long fingers that deals 4 damage and pries at the target's armour, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds and [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snatched Grip
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to an enemy and snatches at its hands, dealing 10 damage and silencing it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

fusions.name: Up the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Pulls out a trick you already used: clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fiddled Odds
fusions.desc: When you go too long without a critical hit, you work out the angle: your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
